newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa may puncture 980 support, then rise.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa may puncture 980 support, then rise.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE July cocoa futures could puncture the key 980 stg support on Friday but there is no danger of the oversold market breaking down, analysts said.
Traders called the market to open a few stg higher.
Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said July could break below 980 stg support level, having collapsed earlier this week on a speculative sell-off.
But the fall will be shortlived and the market could rise again, looking oversold in the short-term.
The nine-day relative strength indicator at 33 percent is just above the oversold zone of 30.
"But there's no clear sign the market is going to break down. It's due for a rally up again," she said.
Resistance is seen at 1,000 stg and this stretch up to 1,025.
Cocoa had been trying to form a top, with July reaching a a peak of 1,061 stg on April 25. But it quickly lost momentum and tumbled to below the 1,000 mark four days later.
New York's cocoa market fell to the lowest in more than two months on Thursday on continued speculative selling and still suffering from a technical breakdown.
Cocoa had been weighed down by news of mounting supplies.

Broker GNI set the tone earlier this week when it cut its 1996/97 world cocoa deficit to just 33,000 tonnes from its earlier forecast of 180,000 tonnes. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
